properties.label: Three dominant weighted values
properties.text: Let three very large numerical shares dominate a dark editorial page. Pair each number with a short label, slider and concise explanation, then reconcile them below with a segmented total bar and a few presets.

properties.label: Clipped rolling numerals
properties.text: Set soft-ivory numerals in individually clipped rolling windows with tabular alignment. The page should read as typography in motion rather than a dashboard of small metric cards.

properties.label: Black-green and sage
properties.text: Use black-green #0c1010, soft ivory numerals and restrained sage accents.

properties.label: Value-bound digit wheels
properties.text: Animate individual digit wheels while the accessible numeric values update immediately. Reduced motion changes digits without rolling.

properties.label: Always-balanced weights
properties.text: Adjusting one weight redistributes the remainder so the total stays exactly 100. Presets set all three shares coherently.

properties.label: Weight extremes and reversals
properties.text: Test 0, 100, all presets and rapid reversals. Bars and values must always reconcile.

properties.label: Responsive numeral integrity
properties.text: Numerals must never clip their final state or wrap on phones.
